risks: DamageModifier 11.2 raises construct melee from about 4.5-6.7k to about 51-76k per swing (1.8 s effective interval under Frost Fever-type slows). Canonical tanks must survive it. Earlier kills at modifier 1 are not comparable for tank or healer metrics.

Bounds are tight (effective 11.244-11.331). The upper bound comes from one unreduced Toxitron row (51,220) that is assumed to carry no unlogged -10% aura (such as a hunter pet's Demoralizing Screech, not checked). If it did, the upper bound loosens to 11.503, and 11.2 stays valid either way.

The timer changes apply to 25N normal as well (DBM normal values do not distinguish size); heroic is untouched. The C++ was edited without a compile (no build allowed): the ternaries use same-type chrono literals.
Matched references are short kills (78.8 s and 88.1 s) with two constructs each. The DPS targets reflect short-fight throughput, as with Magmaw's matched reference.
